messages:
Noah Rivera: Heads up 16: company card got declined on check-in so I charged hotel + city tax on personal card. Also used personal for several dinners (small cafés that often dont give printed receipts) and a few meter parking charges with no ticket. Whats the right way to file? Per-diem for meals or actuals? Any special handling for the hotel VAT/city tax?
Maya (People Ops): Sorry about the card trouble. Short answers: hotel = actuals (attach folio/receipt). Meals = actual receipts when you have them; otherwise per-diem for meals is allowed only if you have no receipts for that day and total per-person meals < per-diem cap. City tax/municipal fees on hotel invoices are reimbursable as actuals. For missing tiny receipts, see lost-receipt rules.
Samir (Finance): Add on: if you used a personal card because the company card failed, mark the expense "company card declined" in the notes and attach a screenshot of the failed charge if you have it (from the hotel or card provider). Currency conversion: we use the FX rate for the transaction date from our vendor. If your bank statement shows USD amounts, upload that as proof.
Elena G.: Quick clarification 16: per-diem is daily for meals only, correct? Does it cover tips?
Maya (People Ops): Correct 16: per-diem covers meals and incidental tips up to the per-diem amount. Per-diem does NOT cover lodging, city taxes, or transportation. If you want per-diem for a day, you must not also claim meal receipts that day. You can mix (actuals for some days, per-diem other days).
ExpenseBot: :receipt: Missing receipt policy: - amount <= $25: file with Lost-Receipt Form (select reason) - $25 < amount <= $75: Lost-Receipt Form + manager approval - amount > $75: not allowed without original receipt unless there is a documented exception from Finance. Attach bank or card statement line for any lost receipt claim.
Maya (People Ops): For hotel VAT reclaim: finance can only reclaim VAT if the invoice is issued to the company (company name and address). If your folio lists your name only, ask the hotel for a corrected invoice. Flag the expense with "VAT reclaim" when submitting. We'll route larger invoices to Samir for follow-up.
Noah Rivera: What about group rides where one person paid the driver (cash) and theres no receipt? We split it later.
Maya (People Ops): Create one expense for the full charge with the original payers receipt if available. In the expense description include a split breakdown and attendees. If no receipt, use the lost-receipt workflow and include a short note about vehicle type, route, date/time, and names. Example description to paste into the expense system:
```
Expense: Taxi (airport -> hotel) - group split
Original payer: Samir
Split: Samir 10.00, Noah 10.00, Elena 10.00
Currency: EUR
Notes: team offsite 2026-03, no printed receipt; attached bank line and photo of taxi meter
```
Samir (Finance): Also note reimbursement timing: expenses approved before payroll cutoff are paid with the next reimbursement run (2x/month). If you need an advance or expedited reimbursement because you fronted a lot on personal cards, ping @people-ops and we'll evaluate.
Elena G.: If the café gave a handwritten slip with merchant name and amount, is that acceptable?
ExpenseBot: Handwritten slips accepted if they include merchant, date, amount, and are legible. Preferred formats: JPEG/PNG or PDF.
Maya (People Ops): Final tips: - Attach card statement lines when using personal cards for proof - Use the "Attendees / Split" field for any shared charges - For recurring problems with company cards, contact eng-infra for replacement or spend limits - If in doubt, submit actuals and tag the expense with a short note; well triage.
Noah Rivera: Awesome, thanks 16: I'll collect the bank lines and photos and submit. Appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
